articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: 2026 midterm elections could stir up headwinds for energy sector. While more industrial builders are being contracted to construct AI infrastructure and data centers, Americans are becoming concerned about what this could all mean for their energy (XLE) and utilities (XLU) bills. Mizuho Americas managing director and senior utilities analyst Anthony Crowdell sits down with Jared Blikre to expand upon how regulators may respond to these worries in 2026, especially in a major mid-term election year. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination. Related tickers mentioned: XLE.
